summary: With the RHDH Operator, add the Ansible dev tools sidecar by editing the Backstage CR (`rhdh.redhat.com/v1alpha4`) and adding a container under `spec.deployment.patch.spec.template.spec.containers` running `adt server` from the ansible-dev-tools-rhel9 image on port 8000; extra env vars go in `spec.application.extraEnvs`.
questions: How do I add the Ansible dev tools sidecar with the RHDH Operator?
Backstage CR containers patch for adt server
How do I add environment variables to the RHDH Operator deployment?

answer_card.title: Dev tools sidecar in the Backstage CR
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
apiVersion: rhdh.redhat.com/v1alpha4
kind: Backstage
metadata:
  name: developer-hub
spec:
  deployment:
    patch:
      spec:
        template:
          spec:
            containers:
              - command: [adt, server]
                image: registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-26/ansible-dev-tools-rhel9:latest
                imagePullPolicy: always
                ports:
                  - containerPort: 8000
                    protocol: TCP
                terminationMessagePolicy: file
```
Edit it in Topology > developer-hub > Edit backstage > YAML.
